Postman's features simplify each step of building an API and streamline collaboration so you can create better APIs—faster.</p></div></div><div class="row same_height_cards"><div class="col-md-12 col-lg-4 mb-4"><div class="v5_card"><div class="v5_card_contents_wrapper text-center"><div class="v5_card-body__with-link"><h3 class="h4">API Client</h3><p>Quickly and easily send REST, SOAP, and GraphQL requests directly within Postman.</p></div><div class="v5_card-cta"><p><a class="v5_link mb-0" href="/product/api-client">Learn More</a></p></div></div></div></div><div class="col-md-12 col-lg-4 mb-4"><div class="v5_card"><div class="v5_card_contents_wrapper text-center"><div class="v5_card-body__with-link"><h3 class="h4">Automated Testing</h3><p>Automate manual tests and integrate them into your CI/CD pipeline to ensure that any code changes won't break the API in production.</p></div><div class="v5_card-cta"><p><a class="v5_link mb-0" href="/automated-testing">Learn More</a></p></div></div></div></div><div class="col-md-12 col-lg-4 mb-4"><div class="v5_card"><div class="v5_card_contents_wrapper text-center"><div class="v5_card-body__with-link"><h3 class="h4">Design &amp; Mock</h3><p>Communicate the expected behavior of an API by simulating endpoints and their responses without having to set up a backend server.</p></div><div class="v5_card-cta"><p><a class="v5_link mb-0" href="/features/mock-api">Learn More</a></p></div></div></div></div><div class="col-md-12 col-lg-4"><div class="v5_card"><div class="v5_card_contents_wrapper text-center"><div class="v5_card-body__with-link"><h3 class="h4">Documentation</h3><p>Generate and publish beautiful, machine-readable documentation to make your API easier to consume.</p></div><div class="v5_card-cta"><p><a class="v5_link mb-0" href="/api-documentation-generator">Learn More</a></p></div></div></div></div><div class="col-md-12 col-lg-4"><div class="v5_card"><div class="v5_card_contents_wrapper text-center"><div class="v5_card-body__with-link"><h3 class="h4">Monitors</h3><p>Stay up-to-date on the health of your API by checking performance and response times at scheduled intervals.</p></div><div class="v5_card-cta"><p><a class="v5_link mb-0" href="/api-monitor">Learn More</a></p></div></div></div></div><div class="col-md-12 href="/use-cases/api-first-development">API-First Development</a></p><p class="mb-4">Release reliable services by building your API before deploying code.</p><p><a class="v5_link" href="/use-cases/application-development">Application Development</a></p><p class="mb-4">Eliminate dependencies and reduce time to production by having front-end and back-end teams work in parallel.</p><p><a class="v5_link" href="/use-cases/api-testing-automation">Automated Testing</a></p><p class="mb-4">Automate manual tests and integrate them into your CI/CD pipeline to ensure that any code changes won't break the API in production.</p></div><div class="col-md-6"><p><a class="v5_link" href="/use-cases/exploratory-testing">Exploratory Testing</a></p><p class="mb-4">Explore the API by sending it different kinds of data to see what values are returned.</p><p><a class="v5_link" href="/use-cases/developer-onboarding">Developer Onboarding</a></p><p class="mb-4">Quickly get consumers up to speed on what your API can do and how it works.</p><p><a class="v5_link" href="/use-cases/developer-portals">Developer Portals</a></p><p class="mb-4">Publish API documentation to help internal and external consumers adopt your APIs.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></section><section class="v5_section v5_background__white v5_wave__light-blue"><div class="container"><h2 Postman is free to download and use for teams of any size.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="col-md-6 col-lg-3 offset-0"><div class="v5_card"><div class="v5_card_contents_wrapper text-center"><div class="v5_card-body__without-cta"><h3 class="h4">Wide support for all APIs and Schemas</h3><p class="mb-0">Make any kind of API call—REST, SOAP, or plain HTTP—and easily inspect even the largest responses. Postman also has built-in support for popular data formats such as OpenAPI GraphQL, and RAML.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="col-md-6 col-lg-3 offset-0"><div class="v5_card"><div class="v5_card_contents_wrapper text-center"><div class="v5_card-body__without-cta"><h3 class="h4">It's Extensible</h3><p class="mb-0">Customize Postman for your needs with the Postman API. Integrate test suites into your preferred CI/CD service with <a class="v5_link" href="https://learning.getpostman.com/docs/postman/collection_runs/command_line_integration_with_newman/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Newman</a>, our command line collection runner.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="col-md-6 col-lg-3 offset-0"><div class="v5_card"><div class="v5_card_contents_wrapper text-center"><div class="v5_card-body__without-cta"><h3 class="h4">Support and Community</h3><p class="mb-0">We continually make improvements and add new features based on feedback from our community of over 8+ million users—who can also help you get the most out of Postman on our</p><p><a class="v5_link" href="https://community.getpostman.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">community forum</a></p></div></div></div></div></div></div></section><section class="v5_section v5_background__white"><div class="container"><div class="row text-center"><div class="col-lg-10 offset-1"><h2>The World Builds Their APIs on Postman</h2><p class="subtitle mb-5">For API developers, the Postman API Network is an easy way to discover and consume the world's most popular APIs.</p></div><div><img alt="" class="lazy-load img-responsive mb-5" data-src="/img/v2/homepage/api-network-on-postman.png"/><p><a class="v5_link" href="https://explore.getpostman.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">View Postman API Network</a></p></div></div></div></section><section class="v5_section v5_background__white v5_wave__light-blue"><div class="container"><div class="row"><div class="col-lg-5"><svg viewbox="0 0 549.76 440.96" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><defs><style>.cls-1,

Pricing</a></li><li class="sidebar-menu-item"><a class="" href="https://learning.getpostman.com/" rel="noopener">Docs</a></li><li class="sidebar-menu-item"><a class="" href="/api-network/" rel="noopener">API Network</a></li><li class="sidebar-menu-item hide-if-signedin"><a href="https://app.getpostman.com/signup?redirect=web" rel="noopener">Sign In</a></li><li class="sidebar-menu-item hide-if-signedout"><a href="https://app.getpostman.com/" rel="noopener">Dashboard</a></li></ul></div><script src="/assets/vendor.js?v=1571682184321" type="application/javascript"></script><script src="/assets/platformVendor.js?v=1571682178142" type="application/javascript"></script><script src="/assets/main.js?v=1571682184375" type="application/javascript"></script><script src="/assets/platformMain.js?v=1571682177763" type="application/javascript"></script><script type="text/javascript">var $body = $('body');

  /**
   * Authentication
   */
  $(function () {
    // Check if the user is signed in and add a class
    // to the body if so. This will hide elements with the
    // .hide-if-signedin class and show elements with
    // the .hide-if-signedout class.
    if (document.cookie.indexOf('getpostmanlogin') > -1) {
      $body.addClass('signedin');
    }
  });

  $(document).on('touchstart', function (e) {
    var thisNodeName = e.target.nodeName;

    if (thisNodeName === 'INPUT' || thisNodeName === 'TEXTAREA') {
      return;
    }

    document.activeElement.blur();
    $('input, textarea').blur();
  });

  /**
   * AWS Slider
   */
  $(function () {
    var $slideController = $('.slide-controller');

    $slideController.on('click', function () {
      var $self = $(this),
        $group = $self.parent().children('.slide-controller'),
        slideIndex;

      slideIndex = $group.index($self);

      $self.addClass('active').siblings().removeClass('active');
      $self
        .parent()
        .next('.slide-content-wrap')
        .children('.slide-contents')
        .css('left', -slideIndex * 100 + '%');
    });
  });

  /**
   * Auto-playing videos
   *
   * Just add a pm-auto-video class to the HTML5 video element
   * and the video will play when visible, and pause when not
   * visible.
   */
  $(function () {
    var $autoVideos = $('video.pm-auto-video'),
      scrollWatch,
      autoVideo = function () {
        $autoVideos.each(function () {
          var $this = $(this);

          if ($this.is(':in-viewport')) {
            $this.get(0).play();
          } else {
            $this.get(0).pause();
          }
        });
      };

    $(document).on('scroll', function () {
      clearTimeout(scrollWatch);
      scrollWatch = setTimeout(autoVideo, 500);
    });
  });

  /**
   * Collection infographic scroll handler
   */
  $(document).ready(function () {
    var tag,
      firstScriptTag;

    // $('.collection_infographic').length && $('.pm-page-wrap').fullpage({
    //   scrollBar: true
    // });

    // Load the YT iFrame API if a video embed exists on the page
    if ($('.pm-resp-yt-wrap').length) {
      tag = document.createElement('script');

      tag.src = "https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api";
      firstScriptTag = document.getElementsByTagName('script')[0];
      firstScriptTag.parentNode.insertBefore(tag, firstScriptTag);
    }
  });

  function onYouTubeIframeAPIReady() {
    var aws_player;

    if ($('#aws-gateway-postman-video').length) {
      aws_player = new YT.Player('aws-gateway-postman-video', {
        videoId: 'pfoKFaHisbY'
      });
    }

    $('[href="#aws-gateway-postman-video-wrap"]').click(function () {
      aws_player.playVideo();
    });
  }

  /**
   * Show native options by default and hide others on the apps page
   */
  $(function () {
    var os,
      arch;

    os = function () {
      var platform = navigator.platform,
        os = 'windows';

      platform.match('Mac') && (os = 'osx');
      platform.match('Win') && (os = 'windows');
      platform.match('Linux') && (os = 'linux');

      return os;
    };

    // Mark the active tab based on detected os
    var tab = $(".app-tabs .app-list li[data-platform='changelog-" + os() + "-app']");
    if (tab.length) {
      $('.app-tabs .app-list li').removeClass('active');
      $('.tab-content .tab-pane').removeClass('active');

      $(tab).addClass('active');
      $('.tab-content #changelog-' + os() + '-app').addClass('active');
    }

    // Update the link & UI when arch is changed
    $('[data-architecture]').on('click', function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();

      var $this = $(this),
        path = $this.children('a').attr('href'),
        plat = $this.data('platform'),
        arch = $this.data('architecture'),
        $label = $this.parent().siblings('.pm-btn').find('.arch-label'),
        $trigger = $this.parents('.dropdown').siblings('.pm-btn');

      // Update the CTA href & dropdown label state
      $trigger.attr('href', path);
      $label.html(arch);
    });
  });</script></body></html>
